Team — forwarding InnoHealth ask. Summary and recommended structure below:

- Ask: 28% off Hosted API list rates for 3-month pilot (5M tokens/mo).
- Condition: Signed SOW with measurable success criteria (latency < 150ms p95, embedding accuracy eval baseline) and 12-month post-pilot minimum spend commitment (TBD, suggested $120k ARR minimum, scales with usage).
- Trade: 28% one-time concession during pilot window only, revert to negotiated blended rate after commit; include option for Reserved Dedicated evaluation after pilot.

Rationale: multi-product pilot across two squads, strong reference potential (large regional health system), opportunity for multi-region expansion. Financially this is dilutive short-term but has upside if we secure the 12-month commit.

Requesting executive sign-off for >20% discount (specifically 28%). Please advise approvals and any additional legal/procurement guardrails.

Approved conditionally. Executive approval granted for up to 28% off list for the 3-month pilot, subject to the following hard requirements before concession is committed:

- Signed SOW (attached) with clear success criteria and a 12-month post-pilot minimum spend clause to be executed within 30 days of pilot completion.

- Legal to include the cap on pilot spend and termination rollback language (no retroactive credits outside these terms).
- All concessions to be recorded in HubSpot (deal DEV-1098) and flagged for quarter-end review with RevOps.

If Legal/Finance can bake those terms into the SOW/quote, Priya — please proceed to send the revised SOW and DocuSign link to InnoHealth.
